recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy 1970s cartoon illustration featuring an anthropomorphic duck character in disco attire, dancing atop a vinyl record against a radiant yellow sunburst and blue background, framed by massive arched bubble lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Character centered within a circular yellow glow
Arched title text following the curve of the background sunburst
Dynamic motion lines and feathers radiating from the central figure
High-contrast black outlines defining all character and letter forms
coreInvariants: Airbrushed gradients for volume on lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central character occupies 60% of the vertical space, standing on a record at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, arched orange title at the top of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion starting from the top title, following the curve down to the dancing feet, and back up through the character's upward-pointing hand.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid blue corners provide breathing room for the dense central composition.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue background and yellow sunburst create a high-energy base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black outlines and deep orange lettering provide structural clarity.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and green accents on the character's clothing and shoes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with bright white highlights to simulate glossy surfaces.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold sans-serif with extreme weight and rounded terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Letters are tightly kerned and overlapping
Arched baseline following a circular path
Heavy black drop shadows for 3D effect
Internal airbrushed gradients from yellow to orange
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'D' and 'K' are flared to anchor the ends of the arch
White 'shine' spots on the top curves of every letter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, volumetric display type paired with loose, energetic hand-drawn script.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar heavy rounded geometry for the base skeleton.
Captures the energetic, messy script quality of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s cartoon illustration of a duck character in a disco outfit dancing on a vinyl record. Use a bright yellow circular sunburst background against a blue field. Include motion lines and floating feathers. Leave the top 30% of the image clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, arched bubble-letter style with orange-to-yellow gradients and thick black outlines. Add secondary credits in a loose, hand-written black script on the right side.

verificationChecks: Does the character have thick black outlines?
Is the color palette limited to vibrant primaries?
Are there glossy white highlights on the letters?

postGenerationChecks: Check for overlapping letters in the title
Ensure the record at the bottom is grounded
Verify the sunburst doesn't overwhelm the character
Confirm the script text is legible but informal
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Heavy Arched Bubble Type] + [Anthropomorphic Character] + [Radial Sunburst] + [Action Motion Lines] to create a 70s novelty aesthetic.
